name: Prajesh SEO
author: Prajesh Ganatra

sections.description:
Prajesh SEO provides a local content workspace, post/page/custom post type metadata, configurable title and description templates, social tags, canonical overrides, indexing requests, WordPress XML sitemap filtering, standard structured data and basic local redirects.

  • WordPress-native wp.element and wp.components backend with local dependencies.
  • Load editable content site-wide in batches, then search/filter the complete snapshot.
  • Edit per-page titles and descriptions in a table; preview and undo batches of up to 100 items.
  • Export all loaded, filtered content as CSV without a paid row allowance.
  • On-demand public output checks: titles, descriptions, canonicals, noindex meta/HTTP headers and JSON-LD syntax.
  • Spot duplicate metadata and repeated schema entity declarations; acknowledge findings per user without hiding the evidence.
  • Undo the last metadata batch per user. Later edits are preserved.
  • Preview supported Yoast or Rank Math post metadata before import. Source metadata is never deleted.
  • Add exact-match 301 or 302 local redirects with loop checks.
  • Optional, bounded 404 logging: paths only, 7 days, 200 entries, sampled to limit writes.
  • Standard Organization/Person, WebSite, BlogPosting and BreadcrumbList schema. WooCommerce remains responsible for product schema.
  • Breadcrumbs shortcode: [prajesh_seo_breadcrumbs].
  • Local operation: no vendor account, telemetry, remote fonts or external API requests.

Known competing SEO plugins pause Prajesh SEO output, sitemap filters, redirects and logging until the conflict is resolved. No other plugins are automatically deactivated.

Scope

Overview counters cover the latest 50 published items. The content workspace separately loads all editable items, with incomplete results clearly labelled. It is a snapshot, not a background index. Bulk edits are processed in batches of 100; this is a request size bound, not a paid allowance.

Public checks inspect one published, unprotected permalink on this exact site origin per request. They fetch without authentication cookies, follow no redirects, execute no JavaScript and inspect at most 512 KB. A blocked, redirected, non-HTML or incomplete response is not verified. Structured-data detection is not a full schema validator. Checks do not confirm Google indexation or rich-result eligibility. Settings changes mark saved reports stale; other integrations and caches can change output, so rerun checks as needed. Maximum 30 checks per minute per user protects server resources.

No taxonomy/archive SEO editor, Search Console, AI, redirect CSV tools or JSON restoration is included. Global settings and redirects do not have undo. JSON export is limited to 2,000 items; content CSV has no item allowance. Migration previews process up to 100 eligible records and skip unsupported variables. Review global templates and schema manually. Single-site WordPress only; network activation is not supported.

Privacy

No data is sent to the developer. If enabled, 404 logging stores request paths and sampled counts. Paths can themselves contain personal data. No IP, query string, user agent or referrer is stored. Logs expire after 7 days and are limited to 200 paths. Turning logging off clears stored paths. The last public verification report is stored on its content item until replaced or deleted; per-user review acknowledgements remain local. Public checks request only your own site and send no content to the developer. Data is preserved on uninstall unless an administrator enables deletion. Batch previews and the last undo batch are stored in user metadata. Previews can be applied for 15 minutes and may remain stored until replaced or consumed; the next metadata batch replaces the last undo record. Exports contain site metadata and should be kept private.
sections.installation:
1. Back up your staging site.
  2. Upload the ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, then activate.
  3. Open Prajesh SEO > Search appearance to set identity, templates and modules.
  4. If replacing another SEO plugin, preview supported metadata under Tools & migration before switching.
  5. Edit content in the Content workspace or the Prajesh SEO metabox in the WordPress editor.
sections.faq:
Does this guarantee indexing or rankings?

No. Settings guide search engines; neither indexation nor ranking is guaranteed.

Does this replace WordPress XML sitemaps?

It uses the core sitemap system and excludes content requesting noindex. Public-site visibility and core sitemap rules still apply.

Are redirects external?

No. Up to 500 rules use exact local URL paths relative to the site home, including subdirectory installations. Query strings are dropped. Network-wide paths and regex are not supported.

What does migration import?

Supported post metadata only: titles, descriptions, canonicals, indexing and social overrides. It skips existing Prajesh SEO metadata and records containing unsupported template variables. It does not import global templates, redirects, schema, taxonomies, analytics or keyword scores.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Preserve backslashes in batch previews, undo history and public verification evidence.
  • Normalize malformed social-image settings safely.
  • Keep verification throttling within a fixed one-minute window.
  • Align the PHP minimum with the verified PHP 8.2 runtime.

1.0.1

  • Preserve literal backslashes in saved metadata.
  • Match local redirect paths correctly on subdirectory sites.
  • Reject missing or invalid redirect deletion keys.
  • Improve source documentation and coding standards.

1.0.0

  • First free release with WordPress wp.element/wp.components backend and website branding.
  • Add site-wide filtering, content CSV export and per-row title/description batch editing.
  • Add same-origin public output verification, evidence, stale-report detection and personal review acknowledgements.
  • Include metadata templates, social/schema output, sitemap integration, local redirects and supported import preview/undo.
